candidates.name: Uterine leiomyoma

uterus not felt separately from the mass
candidates.why: The physical examination findings of a large bosselated mass with restricted mobility arising from the pelvis are consistent with a uterine leiomyoma.

candidates.name: Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC)
support_spans: pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)
candidates.why: The genetic testing results showing a pathogenic variant in the FH gene are consistent with HLRCC, which is caused by mutations in the FH gene.

candidates.name: Reed-Sternberg cell lymphoma
contradict_spans: Serum tumor markers (CA 125, CA 19.9, CEA, AFP, Inhibin and LDH) were within normal limits
candidates.why: The lack of elevated serum tumor markers makes Reed-Sternberg cell lymphoma less likely.

candidates.name: Uterine leiomyoma with malignant transformation
support_spans: Spindle cell tumor composed of elongated cells arranged in long sweeping to poorly formed fascicles
Diffuse hemangiopericytomatous pattern of vasculature
candidates.why: The histopathological findings of a spindle cell tumor with a diffuse hemangiopericytomatous pattern of vasculature are consistent with a uterine leiomyoma with malignant transformation.

candidates.name: Ovarian fibroma
support_spans: Findings were suggestive of an ovarian primary
candidates.why: The imaging findings suggesting an ovarian primary are consistent with an ovarian fibroma.
